description: Anticipation over the four Big5 trait-axis SFT interventions of Phase 2, forecasting reverse-direction spillover onto the coding battery (writing in all nine languages, debug/explain on the four Phase 1 trained languages) and the nine non-coding activities — the mirror image of values_drift_anticipation (coding anchors -> values targets). No target here is a Phase 2 trained task, so all targets are spillover tier and are asked once at described_dataset, per the Phase 1 tiered-target design; the values portraits (the Phase 2 primary outcome) live in the companion spec big5_drift_anticipation with the full level sweep.

target_groups.label: Writing, all nine languages (4 Phase-1-trained + 5 untrained probes)
target_groups.question: Does dialogue training spill over onto coding-language preferences?

target_groups.label: The other eight coding tasks (debug / explain, Phase 1 trained languages)
target_groups.question: Does dialogue training spill over onto other coding tasks?

target_groups.label: Non-coding activities (activity level)
target_groups.question: Does dialogue training shift non-coding activity preferences?

anchor_groups.label: Big5 trait axis, dialogue task fixed

analysis_tiers.secondary: All 26 targets, crossed with each anchor, at described_dataset: none is a Phase 2 trained task, so all are spillover.
